property_summary: In the reference C, setL1BlockValues never stores any parameters, so the public state getters (number, timestamp, basefee, hash, sequenceNumber, batcherHash, l1FeeOverhead, l1FeeScalar) remain zero after any call; the mutant writes them when called from the depositor account (address 0), so the getters return the supplied values.
change_summary: Insert a single tuple assignment storing all parameters into the public state variables after the require check.
